samples.question: A pale sheet is split by four thick dark walls into five vertical strips. A blue dot sits in the far-left strip, and one coloured dot sits in each of the other four strips: cyan, then magenta, then lime, then gold. An open wall has a tall pale gap at its top, so the route can pass; a sealed wall runs top to bottom and blocks everything to its right. The blue dot reaches a coloured dot exactly when every wall to that dot's left is open. How many of the four coloured dots can the blue dot reach? Answer with exactly one of: zero, one, two, three, four.
